_comment: Tracks terms suggested via the site's 'Suggest a term' form. A GitHub Action (term-suggestion-intake.yml) updates this automatically when a labeled issue comes in. When a term is independently suggested 'threshold' times, the Action drafts a pending entry at the bottom of GLOSSARY.md and opens a PR for a maintainer to review - nothing here is ever merged into the real glossary automatically.

candidates.meaning: A command that checks your project's dependencies for known security problems and tells you how many it found.
candidates.picture: A quick health inspection of every ingredient in your pantry, flagging any that have been recalled.
candidates.note: It's just running a routine check, not fixing or changing anything in your code yet.

candidates.meaning: A comment in the code that tells the linter (an automatic style checker) to ignore a specific rule on that line, on purpose.
candidates.picture: A sticky note on one drawer saying "skip inspecting this one, I already checked it."
candidates.note: It's turning off one specific warning deliberately, not disabling all checks or hiding a real problem.

candidates.meaning: A database setting that limits which rows of a table someone is allowed to see or change, even though everyone is querying the same shared table.
candidates.picture: A shared filing cabinet where each drawer only opens for the person whose name is on it, even though the cabinet itself is one piece of furniture everyone uses.
candidates.note: It's telling you the database itself enforces who can touch which data, not just the app's code -- so even a bug in the app can't leak someone else's rows.
